children: Well-known crypto trader Flood said investors should buy HYPE, the native token of decentralized exchange Hyperliquid, instead of other altcoins. The call is based on his view that perpetual futures, which have no expiration date, will become a core financial product for retail investors.

In a post on X on Nov. 26, Flood wrote that Hyperliquid’s airdrop “changed the lives of many people, including me,” and that perpetual futures will dominate the retail investor market over the next decade. Hyperliquid previously distributed 310 million tokens, or 31% of its total supply cap, to existing users for free alongside the token’s launch.

Flood said some investors who came late to the rally after Hyperliquid rose to around $60 believe the remaining upside is limited and are looking for more speculative bets. Rather than chasing short-term gains in other altcoins, he said, it is better to invest in the token of an exchange with real users.

He added that the best time to sell other altcoins and switch into HYPE was Thanksgiving 2024. The second-best time is today. HYPE was trading at around $64 on the day, up about 2% from a day earlier, according to CoinMarketCap.

title: Trader Flood Urges Buying Hyperliquid’s HYPE, Says Perpetual Futures Will Become Core Retail Product
